description: This file contains class definitions for Smarty template engine internal plugins related to the {capture} tag, including compiling and closing capture blocks.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Capture
classes.description: Handles compilation of the Smarty {capture} tag, managing buffer start and capturing output.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_CaptureClose
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {/capture} closing tag, restoring buffer state and closing capture block.

methods.name: compileSpecialVariable
methods.description: Generates PHP code to access the buffer of a capture block using Smarty's internal extension.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for starting a capture block, setting attributes such as buffer name, assign, and append.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for closing a capture block and restoring buffer state.
